title: OmniPhysicsDeformablePoseAPI (bind pose)
summary: Named point sets of a deformable body's meshes, applied as OmniPhysicsDeformablePoseAPI:<name> with an arbitrary instance name. The walkers pick the instance whose purposes name bindPose as the bind pose of the simulation, collision, skin and cooking-source meshes, and each mesh's own points serve without one; see the notes for the purposes name the walkers actually read.

columns.name: deformablePose:<inst>:omniphysics:points
columns.absent: Read only for the instance the walker chose as bind pose. Without the column the simulation mesh's bind points fall back to its points (as for any length mismatch), a skin mesh contributes no bind points, and volume cooking with a separate collision mesh fails ('Cooking failed').
columns.notes: The runtime builds the instance's column name from the template. The cooker writes the bind-pose instance's points for a PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI body, and a change re-parses the deformable body or schedules a re-cook.

columns.name: deformablePose:<inst>:omniphysics:purposes
columns.absent: Not read when parsing: both walkers look for the bindPose purpose under omniphysics:<inst>:purposes instead (see notes), so this column, absent or present, selects no bind pose. The runtime only watches it for changes (re-cook check, re-parse of a registered bind-pose instance).
columns.notes: Token-dictionary ids; the schema allows bindPose and selfCollisionFilterPose.

notes: Instance names are arbitrary, so no instances are declared.

Reader mismatch: both walkers read omniphysics:<inst>:purposes (the ovstage walker as one scalar token, the USD walker as a token array), not the schema property deformablePose:<inst>:omniphysics:purposes. On a schema-conformant stage no bind-pose instance is found, so every mesh uses its own points as bind pose and deformablePose:<inst>:omniphysics:points is never read.
